title: Choose the page structure
question: The Cabin East brand is fixed (Tangra red, cream, slab lettering, pint-stack logo). Pick how the website is put together.

options.label: The Hoarding
options.lineage: Goa shopfront under fit-out, site hoarding with pasted street posters
options.thesis: While the shop is being built, the website is its hoarding: the menu pasted up as posters.
options.viewport: A red plywood hoarding fills the screen; one big pasted poster carries the logo, OPENING SOON IN BETALBATIM and two buttons; dish posters overlap at its edges.
options.risk: Pasted-poster overlap can get busy; needs one poster clearly in charge.

options.label: The Steamer Stack
options.lineage: bamboo dim sum steamers stacked at the pass
options.thesis: The page is a stack of steamer baskets; each section is a basket lifted to show what is inside.
options.viewport: An open steamer seen from above, dumplings inside, logo and opening line set beside it on cream; the next basket's rim peeks below.
options.risk: Strongest on dim sum; the beer has to earn its place lower down.

options.label: Down the Pint
options.lineage: the pint-stack logo read top to bottom
options.thesis: Scroll down through the logo itself: foam and draught, then the steamer, then the wok flame, then the door.
options.viewport: A tall pint glass at hero scale on ink, foam at the top, the three layers labelled DRAUGHT, STEAM, WOK as the page navigation.
options.risk: Dark first screen leans bar-at-night; lunch and family visitors may read it as late-night only.
